Two built-in clocks, settled. Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "and hours_since_first_launch or something could be separate", then "ok, keep running_hours and hours_since_start". `running_hours`: the learner line's running time (as steered). `hours_since_start`: wall time since the run first started (its first attempt began on a machine; queue time excluded), gaps included; this replaces `WALL_CLOCK = "wall_seconds"` with the same meaning in hours (delete wall_seconds, no second wall clock). Both recorded by Etude on every row and checkpoint, both usable as `until`, checkpoint cadence, report axis and seat clocks. Metric timers such as `time/collection` stay seconds (Flame). Hours were checked against Tinker and prime-rl (step-based, time only as metrics) and W&B (`_runtime` seconds, process vs wall relative time); hours kept for budgets.
